nouns_meishi.properties: No inflection, no grammatical gender, no morphological singular/plural distinction, no definite/indefinite articles.
subclasses: 形式名詞 (Formal nouns: こと, もの, ため, わけ)

verbs_doushi.properties: Always clause/sentence-final in canonical syntax; inflects through 6 stems (未然形, 連用形, 終止形, 連体形, 仮定形, 命令形); no person or number agreement.

i_adjectives.properties: Unique inflectional category ending in 'い'; conjugates similarly to verbs (高い -> 高くない -> 高かった -> 高くて).

na_adjectives_keiyoudoushi.properties: Nominal adjectives; functions as noun modifiers via particle 'な' (静かな部屋) and predicatively via copula 'だ/です' (静かだ).

particles_joshi.properties: The load-bearing clitic class specifying grammatical relation, discourse status, coordination, and mood.

auxiliary_verbs_jodoushi.properties: Clitic verb suffixes attaching to stems to express tense, aspect, politeness, voice, and modality.

counters_josuushi.properties: Obligatory numerical classifiers matched to semantic noun geometry.

items.人 (nin): Humans (ひとり, ふたり, さんにん)

pronouns_daimeishi.properties: Infrequently used compared to European languages; zero-pronoun drop or titles preferred.
